abilities.name: Vigorous Swipe
abilities.description: The mammoth swings its tusks around in front of itself, indicated by a wide red cone, dealing continuous moderate physical damage to its target.

abilities.name: Stomp
abilities.description: The mammoth rears back and stomps the ground in front of itself, indicated by a red circle, dealing moderate physical damage and staggering its target. Blocking prevents the stagger.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: The mammoth charges forward, indicated by a red rectangle, dealing high physical damage and knocking down its target. Blocking prevents the knockdown.

Everlasting Fair Mammoths are large creatures usually found herded by giants. They are most commonly found in the Rift and Eastmarch, though they can be found in Wrothgar, northern Cyrodiil, and the western regions of Valenwood. When killed, they may drop a lead for the Rune-Carved Mammoth Skull furnishing.
